decision: TypeScript: fallow audit (introduced-only gate, --max-crap 30 default, --coverage Istanbul, per-analysis baselines, exit mirrors verdict); Dart/Python: jscpd 5 --baseline + --fail-on-new-clones + console reporter (file reporters write into the tree); baseline via one explicit --update-baseline run; mutation: Stryker for JS/TS, mutmut 3 for Python (pytest required, [tool.mutmut] source_paths), Dart none.
question: Which tool gates clones, complexity, and CRAP per stack with machine-readable output, and which mutation runner per language
unknown: mutmut on a repository without a pytest suite has no kill signal; Stryker config per repository
verified: fallow audit: changed-file gate over dead code, complexity, duplication; verdict pass/warn/fail with exit code; --max-crap default 30; --coverage coverage-final.json; per-analysis baselines
jscpd 5.1.1: --baseline + --update-baseline create the baseline, --fail-on-new-clones exits 1 on a new pair, console reporter prints [NEW] with both files; observed locally
fallow 3.22.0 audit --format json observed locally: kind=audit, verdict, summary, attribution
mutmut 3: pytest-only runner, pyproject [tool.mutmut] source_paths + pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection, mutates only called functions, timeout = (original duration + 1) x 15
